entries.notes: Subject, tonal centre A; mm. 1–2, with the final note tied to the first quarter of m. 3. Endpoint includes the final note's written duration and ties.
Answer, tonal centre C; mm. 3–4, with the final note tied to the first quarter of m. 5. Endpoint includes the final note's written duration and ties.
Subject, tonal centre A; mm. 7–8, with the final note tied through the first five quarter-note units of m. 9. Endpoint includes the final note's written duration and ties.

analysis.description: Opening subject and answer statements only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Foster's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The interlude occupies mm. 5–6. Only the first-subject exposition is represented; the second subject introduced at m. 28 is outside this excerpt. The final tied note extends past the exposition cadence. Manual score transcription of opening subject and answer statements, checked against Dorothy Nell Foster (1973), Chapter IV. Quarter-note units; entry ends include the final note and all its written ties. Excerpts extend through the final subject release when it passes the exposition cadence. No recording timing has been estimated. A short independently engraved subject incipit is included; the source score, thesis prose and chart images are not redistributed.
